Appendix

Metric Definitions
Total Tickets All open post-tooled tickets (excluding Completed, Rejected, and Cancelled) updated within the last 24 hours.
New Tickets All post-tooled tickets created within the last 24 hours.
Resolved Tickets All post-tooled tickets resolved within the last 24 hours.
High Severity (Resolved) All post-tooled tickets resolved within the last 24 hours with High Severity.
High Severity (Open) All open post-tooled tickets updated within the last 24 hours with High Severity.
New High Severity All post-tooled tickets created in the last 24 hours with High Severity.

Note: Only a maximum of 100 tickets can be queried
